answer: Use escalating bonds tied to shared funding and behaviour clusters. Each new identity locks 150 units; identities funded from the same wallet or repeating the same task pattern count as one cluster, and the bond doubles per extra member: 150, 300, 600, and so on. A nebula of similar accounts therefore collapses into one costly cluster instead of many cheap ones. Each voyage is scored per cluster, and a vertex identity sharing funding or behaviour with another pays the escalated bond, so one fake costs 150 units while ten clustered fakes lock over 150,000 units.
